acceptance: Acceptance runs ops/tests/test_worktree_registry_queries.py and must prove active-only, exact branch/slug/path selectors, fields projection, summary/conflicts output, zero live facts for --no-liveness, and rc64 fail-closed negative controls. The legacy list --json payload remains unchanged when no query flag is supplied. The registry query flags and their projection/no-liveness semantics are documented in docs/reference/tech_index.md.
brief: 查一個正在執行的工作也必須掃描並輸出整份歷史紀錄，協調者白等且浪費大量閱讀空間。
detail: 唯讀調查在 60 筆 active 狀態下兩次呼叫 worktree_registry.py list --json；CLI 沒有 active、branch、slug、fields、summary 或 no-liveness 投影，因此每個小問題都必須分類並輸出整份歷史 ledger，再靠 jq 丟棄。兩次 live classification 各約 27 秒；R6 報告觀測約 4,014 行，R8 觀測約 153 KB、44 秒。需要 fail-closed 的 compact query surface，至少支援 active-only、branch/slug/path 精確查詢、欄位投影、summary/conflicts，以及可選的 no-liveness 快路徑；預設 agent-facing output 應只含決策欄位與完整 artifact 路徑。不得改變既有完整 list --json schema。
plan: 1. Add composable list query flags --active-only, --branch, --slug, --path, --fields, --summary, --conflicts, and --no-liveness while preserving the legacy list --json schema when no new flag is present. 2. Filter the ledger by pure status and identity selectors before live classification; --no-liveness performs zero git facts/classifier calls and fields are validated against a whitelist with absolute artifact paths. 3. Keep summary/conflicts compact and fail closed on unknown fields, empty selectors, or mutually exclusive output modes. 4. Document the agent-facing query contract in docs/reference/tech_index.md in the same change and cover it with a 60-record counted fixture.
scope: 登記簿查詢介面與效能測試，一支工具的中型改善。
verified_evidence: set -o pipefail; ./ops/worktree_registry.py list --help | rg -q -- '--json'; ! ./ops/worktree_registry.py list --help | rg -q -- '--active-only|--branch|--slug|--fields|--summary|--no-liveness'
